en: A monochrome postcard showing a tall, rectangular stone monument standing on a small rise among pine trees. The pillar-like structure has a darker rectangular plaque on its front face, decorated with a vertical sword or cross motif and surrounded by text that is difficult to read. Above the plaque is a circular wreath relief. In the foreground are low stone posts connected by chains and simple white crosses, suggesting a war memorial or commemorative grave site.
